title: pentanema salicinum subsp. asperum
intro: Pentanema salicinum subsp. asperum, commonly known as a plant species in the family Asteraceae, is a type of flowering plant that is native to certain regions. This plant is known for its medicinal properties, particularly in reducing inflammation and pain due to its health benefits, which include being used to treat fever, rheumatism, and sore throats. The therapeutic actions of Pentanema salicinum subsp. asperum are attributed to its anti-inflammatory, analgesic, and antipyretic properties. The bioactive constituents of this plant include salicylic acid, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
